title: "Call for Bangkok 2026 session chairs"
date: 2026-01-23
categories: [Community]
description: "Six thematic tracks; proposals due 15 May. ECRs especially encouraged."
---

We are now accepting proposals for session chairs at the MIDSEA 2026 symposium in Bangkok. The symposium will feature six thematic tracks, and we particularly encourage applications from early-career researchers. Proposals are due by 15 May 2026.
